description: This Swift source file defines the LiveActivityManager class responsible for managing live activities related to the 'OpenClaw' app. It handles starting, updating, and ending live activities, as well as managing their connection states, including cleanup of stale activities.

classes.name: LiveActivityManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing the lifecycle and states of live activities within the app, including starting, updating, and removing stale activities.

methods.name: startActivity
methods.description: Initiates a new live activity with specified agent name and session key, handling authorization and activity creation.

methods.name: handleConnecting
methods.description: Updates the current activity state to 'Connecting...'.

methods.name: handleReconnect
methods.description: Updates the current activity state to 'Idle'.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Updates the current activity state to 'Disconnected'.

methods.name: hydrateCurrentAndPruneDuplicates
methods.description: Ensures only one active activity remains, ending duplicates and setting the current activity accordingly.

methods.name: updateCurrent
methods.description: Updates the state of the current activity asynchronously.

methods.name: connectingState
methods.description: Returns the activity content state representing a connecting status.

methods.name: idleState
methods.description: Returns the activity content state representing an idle status.

methods.name: disconnectedState
methods.description: Returns the activity content state representing a disconnected status.
